description: Batch steps in one call. Start cold with {"goto":url}. Success returns page changes; failure stops with candidates, console/network errors and page changes.

steps.description: Steps: {"goto":url} {"click":t} {"dblclick":t} {"hover":t} {"focus":t} {"fill":[t,value]} {"type":[t,text]} {"press":key} {"select":[t,option]} {"upload":[t,path]} {"check":t} {"uncheck":t} {"scroll":{"by":px|"to":t}} {"wait":ms|{"text":s}|{"url_contains":s}} {"expect":{"visible":t|"hidden":t|"text":s|"url_contains":s|"value":v,"target":t|"download":"*.pdf"}} {"shot":label} {"eval":js}. t: ref, name, css=/xpath=. Secrets: {{env:VAR}}. Use expect guards. Downloads auto-save. Compounds: {"if":{"visible":t,"then":[],"else":[]}} {"try":[]} {"repeat":{"do":[],"until":cond,"max":N}}. Capture extract/fetch/eval with as:"name"; reuse typed {$var:"name.path"} arguments. Example: [{"extract":t,"as":"data"},{"return":{"$var":"data"}}]. eval returns data only with as. extract: t or {target,fields,offset,limit,maxChars}; fetch: URL or {url,method,body,headers}. {"dialog":{"accept":bool,"text":s}} (before its trigger) {"drag":[t,t]} {"back":true} Also: forward reload resize clipboard cookies wait_response emulate http_auth headers mock har trace pdf sockets workers; {"syntax":"mock"} shows one, free.
